diagnosis.bottom_flux_observable: For mode 5, solve_result.bottom_flux is materialized after HeadCalc from exact legacy watstor()+fluxes() interval water-balance arithmetic; it is not an independently exposed instantaneous terminal Darcy-face operator.
diagnosis.conductivity_time_level: Under the frozen Stage-A SWKIMPL=0 configuration, HeadCalc resets K and Kmean before nonlinear iteration and does not update K/Kmean after each head update. The accepted mode-5 residual therefore uses lagged start-of-step last-node conductivity with the accepted/current head gradient.
diagnosis.consequence: The original audit compared an end-state current-K Darcy operator against an interval-balance qbot produced by a lagged-K solve. Failure of the identity gates cannot be attributed to the LARE boundary closure.

scientific_disposition: No BC1 candidate is accepted or rejected from Stage A.
BC1_SOURCEFACE remains a no-fit sensitivity candidate; its larger Stage-A difference is not used to tune any coefficient.
A2 will verify exact Reference boundary semantics using start-of-step K and accepted end-state gradient, while keeping interval-balance qbot distinct from instantaneous operator semantics.
Reduced-dynamics qualification must compare integrated exchange and storage over identical forcing histories, not relabel interval qbot as an instantaneous Darcy flux.
